verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a compliance automation SaaS, so letting users schedule recurring jobs or workflows is a fair axis, but the pack documents no user-configurable scheduler. The closest items are adjacent: monitors and integrations refresh data "up to daily or ad-hoc" on the platform's own cadence, and access reviews send reminders "according to your policy's timelines." Neither lets a user define and schedule a recurring job or workflow, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
